content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court Sonepur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://sonepur.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Court Sonepur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the District Court Sonepur Recruitment 2026 is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 22 vacancies are available for the posts of Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist, Junior Typist, and Stenographer Grade-III in the District Court Sonepur Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for applicants is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a +3 examination or equivalent from a recognized university, a Diploma in Computer Application, and passed Odia at M.E. standard. Specific typing and shorthand speeds are also required for certain posts.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the District Court Sonepur Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the District Court Sonepur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per Pay matrix Level 4 or Level 7 as per ORSP 2017. Specifically, Jr. Clerk-cum-Copyist and Junior Typist will receive Rs.19,900/- to Rs.63,200/-, while Stenographer Grade-III will receive Rs.25,500/- to Rs.81,100/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the District Court Sonepur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Computer Science Test (Practical), Typewriting Test, Shorthand & Type Test, and a Viva Voce Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Court Sonepur, which is https://sonepur.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the filled application form.
